crossRefs.note: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice, and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among…
Behold, to Yahweh your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.
Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”
